title: Kawat Galvanis Lapis Tipis Cepat Berkarat, Ini Bedanya
hook: Kawat galvanis lapis tipis dipukul sekali ke palet langsung rusak lapisannya
story: Sejak detik 0.0s di gudang material, mandor mengangkat satu untaian kawat duri galvanis dan memukulkannya dua kali ke bibir palet kayu. Kawat tidak patah dan lapisan seng tidak mengelupas. Ia mengangkat untaian itu ke samping label krem roll Kawat Duri Diamond, memutar pergelangan pelan supaya lapisan seng tebal dan jarak duri yang rapat terlihat jelas, lalu menatap lensa dan menyebut PT Intan Suar Kartika dengan tenang.
caption:
Kawat galvanis lapis tipis cepat berkarat, pagar kebun jadi cepat bobol. Kawat Duri Diamond dari PT Intan Suar Kartika lapisan sengnya tebal dan durinya rapat jadi tetap utuh di kebun. Mau tanya ukuran BWG yang pas? Kirim pesan ke DM.

shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 12 seconds, one continuous take, shot on smartphone vlog camera at chest height with gentle natural handheld sway, authentic documentary footage look, natural clean daylight neutral white balance, true-to-life colors, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, no plastic shine, no waxy skin, no glass skin, no yellow or orange tint, no artificial golden glow, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look, clean frame without camera HUD, no REC icon, no viewfinder brackets, no camera display overlay, no on-screen text or captions of any kind. Location: a hardware stock yard beside stacked wooden pallets in Medan, plain grey concrete floor, blurred sacks of building material in the background, ordinary slightly overcast mid-morning daylight. The wire coil is exactly the product in the single attached official reference photo: a tight cylindrical coil of bright shiny galvanized barbed wire with four-point barbs, tied with a round cream-coloured card label on the front printed with red bands and a red circular stamp. Person: an Indonesian construction foreman about 42 years old, dusty dark grey work shirt with rolled sleeves, dark work trousers, brown cotton work gloves, dusty yellow safety helmet, tanned skin, calm composed face. PROP CONTINUITY RULE: from 0.0s to 12.0s exactly two product objects are present, the single coil of galvanized barbed wire with its cream label resting on the wooden pallet and one loose cut strand of the same barbed wire held in the foreman's gloved hand, together with the pallet and the foreman; the coil, label, strand, pallet and man never duplicate, reshape, float, vanish or appear from nowhere. BEATS: at 0.0s, in the very first frame, the foreman is already raising the loose barbed wire strand and striking it sharply twice against the edge of the wooden pallet, the strand stays straight and does not snap while the grey zinc coating shows no flaking, and he says in calm unhurried Indonesian with accurate lip sync, "Kawat galvanis lapis tipis cepat berkarat". From 4.0s to 7.5s he lifts the intact strand beside the cream label of the coil and slowly turns his wrist so the camera can see the thick even zinc coating and the tight even barb spacing, keeping the gesture small and steady. From 8.5s to 11.0s he lowers his hand, faces the lens squarely and finishes calmly, "Kawat Duri Diamond PT Intan Suar Kartika tetap utuh", then holds still. Ambient yard sounds only, no music. Smooth natural motion, stable hands, consistent lighting, no flicker, no morphing.
